title: Neymar is three photos away from Queen Elizabeth II
description: Three real photos link Neymar to Queen Elizabeth II, by way of a Brazilian president and a future king.
hook: How is Neymar connected to Queen Elizabeth the Second?

links.line: In July 2019, at the Copa América final in Rio, Neymar posed with Brazil's president Jair Bolsonaro.

image.file: File:2019 Reunião Bilateral com o Príncipe Charles - 48947648318.jpg

links.line: That October in Tokyo, Bolsonaro met Prince Charles; both had come for Japan's new emperor's enthronement ceremony.

image.file: File:Queen Elizabeth II Platinum Jubilee 2022 - Platinum Pageant (52123563502).jpg

links.line: And in 2022, Charles stood beside his mother, Queen Elizabeth the Second, for her Platinum Jubilee on the palace balcony.
